summary: Read a matrix of integers with m rows and n columns, then read one target integer. Two facts hold. Inside a single row, values become larger while moving from the left side toward the right side. The leftmost value of any row is strictly larger than the rightmost value of the row sitting just above it. Decide whether the target integer occurs in the matrix. Write true when it occurs and false when it does not. A matrix with no cells counts as absent. Every row has the same length.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
